title: A ticked customer another user moved meanwhile is left alone
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You and a second user, {User-B}, are both signed in with the "Admin" role, in two separate browsers.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4 Second Admin.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 20 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly two customers, {Customer-A} and {Customer-B}.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-31 N20, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-31 Alpha and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-31 Bravo.
  • Starting screen: your browser shows the Credit Terms page; {User-B}'s browser shows Edit Customer for {Customer-B}.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. In {User-B}'s browser, set Credit Terms to Net 60.
  5. In {User-B}'s browser, click Save.
  6. In your browser, click "Move 2 Customers".
  7. Open {Customer-B}'s customer page.
  8. On the Credit Terms page, open the "⋯" page menu.
  9. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: the button reads "Move 2 Customers".
  • Step 4: the dropdown shows Net 60.
  • Step 5: {Customer-B} is saved on Net 60.
  • Step 6: the toast reads "1 customer moved to Net 45." (only {Customer-A} is counted).
  • Step 7: {Customer-B} is on Net 60 (left alone), with no move note.
  • Step 8: the menu opens.
  • Step 9: the new "Customers moved" row reads "1 customer from {Term-A} to Net 45".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers), story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S4-E1: “A customer ticked in the window whose term another user changed meanwhile is left alone and not counted in the toast.”
  • S12-E3: “A move where some ticked customers had already left the term (S4-E1) logs the number actually moved.”
